title: Neighbor saw backyard lit up like a Hollywood set

tellings.quote: goes he goes your backyard was lit up like a Hollywood set or something

plain: In 2017, at his home in Georgia, a neighbor told Mario Woods, a veteran who says he has had encounters of his own, that his backyard had been "lit up like a Hollywood set or something." Woods repeats what the neighbor told him. He offers it as an outside witness to strange lights at his house.
